summary: Preserve host-defined clock precision reduction and isolation-dependent timing resolution for high-resolution timestamps.

semantics.monotonicity: coarsening must preserve required monotonic-clock semantics

caveats: Do not promise a specific timer resolution or map directly to DateTime.UtcNow.

tests.name: precision may be reduced
tests.expected_behavior: returns a Number; fractional precision is host-policy dependent

tests.name: do not hardcode microseconds
tests.expected_behavior: no portable fixed result; implementation may coarsen time
